name: var-swatch
description: See the real color behind every CSS and SCSS variable — resolved through chains, @use modules, color functions and themes.

varSwatch.include.description: Glob patterns of stylesheet files to index in the workspace.

varSwatch.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from workspace indexing. Files reached through @use/@import are still resolved on demand.

varSwatch.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files indexed eagerly at startup.

varSwatch.loadPaths.description: Extra Sass load paths (relative to the workspace folder).

varSwatch.themes.enable.description: Detect theme overrides ([data-theme], .dark, @media (prefers-color-scheme)) and show every variant.

enumDescriptions: Only the native VS Code color square for the default value.
Native square plus small extra swatches for each theme variant.
A Var Swatch inline square after each resolved variable, without the native VS Code color square.
A Var Swatch inline square after each resolved variable plus small extra swatches for each theme variant.
varSwatch.decoration.style.description: How resolved colors are displayed inline.

varSwatch.decoration.highlight.description: Paint the variable name itself with its resolved color (with a readable black or white text color), in addition to the inline swatches.

varSwatch.decoration.highlightOpacity.description: Opacity of the highlight background, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (solid). Below 0.5 the text keeps the theme's color.

varSwatch.hover.enable.description: Show the resolution chain, source location and WCAG contrast on hover.
